description: This file is a C/C++ header file defining the interface for Harvester RBus API functions, including functions for getting/setting MLO RFC status, interacting with PSM database, initializing and uninitializing RBus, and retrieving various Wi-Fi related diagnostic data.

methods.name: get_HarvesterMLORfcEnable
methods.description: Gets the current status of MLO RFC enable flag.

methods.name: set_HarvesterMLORfcEnable
methods.description: Sets the MLO RFC enable flag and persists that to PSM.

methods.name: regHarvesterDataModel
methods.description: Initializes and registers the MLO RFC RBUS data elements.

methods.name: rbus_StoreValueIntoPsmDB
methods.description: Stores a TR181 parameter value into the PSM database.

methods.name: rbus_GetValueFromPsmDB
methods.description: Fetches a TR181 parameter value from the PSM database.

methods.name: get_rbus_handle
methods.description: Returns the rbus handle for harvester.

methods.name: harvesterRbusInit
methods.description: Initializes the RBUS for the harvester component.

methods.name: rbus_getBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from a specified TR181 path.

methods.name: rbus_getStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from a specified TR181 path.

methods.name: rbus_getUInt32Value
methods.description: Retrieves a Uint32 value from a specified TR181 path.

methods.name: rbus_getApAssociatedDeviceDiagnosticResult
methods.description: Fetches Wi-Fi associated device diagnostic results, including MLO devices.
